<!-- ===== COVER LETTER ===== -->
::: {.cover-letter-section}

## Dear Hiring Manager, {.section-heading}

::: {.letter-body}

I am writing to express my strong interest in a **Principal Data Engineering
& Analytics** role. With a career that spans from managing driver divisions
at Knight Transportation to architecting production data platforms at Select
Water Solutions, I offer a rare combination of deep transportation domain
knowledge and advanced technical expertise in SQL, Python, dbt, and Power BI.

### From the Field to the Data Layer

In my current role as a Principal Data Engineering & Analytics Analyst at
Select Water Solutions — promoted from Senior Data Analyst — I architect and
own production data platforms, not just the dashboards built on top of them.
I built and maintain 8+ FastAPI analytics applications on a shared company
platform, authored the row-level-security access pattern now used across
every dashboard, and led a test-coverage initiative that put a CI gate in
front of every merge. Earlier in the role, I reconciled site inventory data
across four major regions — NE, Rockies, Permian, and MidCon — documenting
troubleshooting frameworks to resolve discrepancies and ensure reporting
accuracy. This experience in maintaining data integrity across Postgres, dbt,
and Dataverse environments directly aligns with any organization's need for
an analyst who understands data quality frameworks and governance at scale.

### Operations Intuition Meets Technical Depth

What sets me apart is my foundational experience in the logistics industry.
During my tenure at Knight Transportation, I led a fleet of 60+ drivers and
successfully reduced idle time from 55% to 20% while increasing gross revenue
by 12%. I understand the "day in the life" of transportation processes, which
allows me to evaluate systems and identify inefficiencies that a purely
technical analyst might overlook.

### Making Data Speak to Everyone

I have a proven ability to translate complicated analytics for non-technical
stakeholders. Whether it was reducing Medicare fraud case preparation time from
3 weeks to 2 days for the Tennessee Attorney General's Office, or developing
global dashboards for HP, I focused on making data accessible and actionable.
I also led the enterprise-wide migration from Domo to Power BI at Select
Water, eliminating $1.2M in external consulting fees through internal resource
optimization and technical leadership.

I am eager to bring my entrepreneurial mindset and technical toolkit to help
drive insights and operational excellence. Thank you for your time and
consideration.

**Sincerely,**

**Edward Shane Christian**

📧 [schristian625@aol.com](mailto:schristian625@aol.com) · 📱 615-852-0233 · 🔗 [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/shane-christian-data/)

:::
:::


<!-- ===== WHAT I DO ===== -->
::: {.what-i-do-section}

## What I Bring to the Table {.section-heading}

::: {.value-grid}

::: {.value-card}
#### 🔍 Data Reconciliation & Governance
Multi-system data reconciliation across Postgres, Dataverse, and reporting
layers. I build troubleshooting frameworks that make data integrity repeatable,
not heroic.
:::

::: {.value-card}
#### 📊 Dashboard Design & BI Strategy
Power BI dashboards with drill-through capabilities — from global HP initiatives
to regional operational KPIs. I design for the decision-maker, not the data
model.
:::

::: {.value-card}
#### ⚡ Process Optimization
Operations background means I see inefficiencies others miss. I've turned 3-week
processes into 2-day turnarounds and identified $4K/month in unbilled revenue
hiding in plain sight.
:::

::: {.value-card}
#### 🤝 Stakeholder Translation
Attorneys, executives, nurses, drivers — I've built analytics for all of them.
I bridge the gap between technical complexity and business clarity.
:::

:::
:::

::: {.tech-stack-section}

## Core Toolkit {.section-heading}

::: {.tech-grid}

::: {.tech-card}
#### Data & Query
SQL · Postgres · Microsoft SQL · AS400 · Dataverse · Azure Databases
:::

::: {.tech-card}
#### BI & Visualization
Power BI · Dashboard Design · Data Modeling · DAX · Quarto
:::

::: {.tech-card}
#### Engineering & Automation
Python · DBT · Automation Tools · ETL Pipelines · DBeaver · Sequel ViewPoint
:::

::: {.tech-card}
#### Workflow & Collaboration
Jira · Service Desk · MS Office Suite · Git · Agile Environments
:::

:::
:::
